component.name: ProbeScene
component.script: sub init() modes = ["scaleToFit"] x = 60 for each mode in modes first = m.top.createChild("Poster") first.translation = [x, 400] first.width = 300 first.height = 100 first.loadDisplayMode = mode first.uri = "pkg:/images/quad.png" later = m.top.createChild("Poster") later.translation = [x + 400, 400] later.width = 300 later.height = 100 later.uri = "pkg:/images/quad.png" later.loadDisplayMode = mode x = x + 300 end for m.changed = [] x = 60 for each mode in modes poster = m.top.createChild("Poster") poster.translation = [x, 700] poster.width = 300 poster.height = 100 poster.uri = "pkg:/images/quad.png" poster.addField("pendingMode", "string", false) poster.pendingMode = mode x = x + 300 end for m.timer = m.top.findNode("timer") m.timer.observeField("fire", "onTimer") m.timer.control = "start" end sub sub onTimer() for i = 0 to m.top.getChildCount() - 1 child = m.top.getChild(i) if child.hasField("pendingMode") then child.loadDisplayMode = child.pendingMode end for end sub
